premise.claim: When a RoleBasedGroup / RoleBasedGroupSet is deleted and recreated with the same name, the new object gets a new UID while the predecessor's children can linger until GC removes them. ... A recreated RoleBasedGroupSet listed children purely by the set-name label, so it could delete a foreign child on scale-down, rewrite its spec, and count it as Ready in status. The RBG controller read a bound RoleBasedGroupScalingAdapter by name and let it override role replicas... Both gang-scheduling PodGroup implementations reused the PodGroup found by name and rewrote its spec while keeping the old controller reference; the Volcano path also never adopted orphans, leaking them past deletePodGroup.
premise.reportedComponent: RoleBasedGroupSet controller, RBG controller scaling-adapter paths, k8s-scheduler-plugin and volcano PodGroup management
premise.evidence: On base 56c49531: foreign-UID child RBG deleted on scale-down; foreign bound adapter overrode replicas 1->5; foreign PodGroup MinMember rewritten 7->2 (volcano + k8s-scheduler-plugin); envtest: 3/3 recreate-scenario specs fail on base. results/l1-*-base.txt, results/l2-envtest-base.txt
